# 사잇길부산 / SayItGil BUSAN

> Mother-of-pearl craft workshops with Korean tea in Nam-gu, Busan, South Korea (48526). 부산 남구에서 운영하는 자개 소품 만들기와 다도 체험.

Official website: https://www.sayitgil.net/. Workshops last about 60 minutes and are offered in Korean and English. Guests take home one finished item. Address: 2F, 119 Dongmyeong-ro, Nam-gu, Busan, South Korea (48526). Information updated 2026-10-16; final prices, availability and group conditions must be confirmed at booking.

## Experience and visitor information

- [Bilingual experience guide](https://www.sayitgil.net/experience.md): Korean and English descriptions, KRW prices, duration, address, inclusions, FAQs and group arrangements.
- [Human-readable experience guide](https://www.sayitgil.net/experience-guide.html): The same visitor information as a public HTML page.
- [Official homepage](https://www.sayitgil.net/): Workshop photos, craft items and travel partner information.

## Booking and contact

- [Individual booking](https://www.sayitgil.net/booking.html): Opens the official booking service. Check current availability and final prices here.
- [Group inquiry](https://www.sayitgil.net/#inquiry): Travel agencies, DMCs, corporate and MICE groups; request a quote by date, headcount, time and venue. Email partnership@sayitgil.net; telephone +82 51-711-0819.
